Each employee filled out a profile including three likes or hobbies. On the day of the gift exchange, only eleven gifts were given, each one specific to one of the recipient's interests. path = "/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/cffe0e32-c9a6-4c52-9877-78ceb4aaa9fb.docx"

```python
employees = []
for i in range(2, 14):
    name = doc.paragraphs[i].text.strip()
    if name:
        employees.append(name)

# Profiles in lines 21-32
profiles = {}
for i in range(21, 33):
    line = doc.paragraphs[i].text.strip()
    if ":" in line:
        name, rest = line.split(":", 1)
        interests = [x.strip() for x in rest.split(",")]
        profiles[name.strip()] = interests

# Gifts in lines 36-46
gifts = []
for i in range(36, 47):
    g = doc.paragraphs[i].text.strip()
    if g:
        gifts.append(g)

print("Employees:")
for e in employees:
    print(e)
print("\nProfiles:")
for n, ints in profiles.items():
    print(n, ints)
print("\nGifts:")
for g in gifts:
    print(g)
```

I'll map each gift to a likely interest and then mark which employees are covered. The unmatched employee will represent the missed recipient; under the assumed one-to-one cycle, we'll infer that person did not give a gift.

```python
# Map gifts to interests
interest_map = {
    "Galileo Galilei biography": "Astronomy",
    "Fishing reel": "Fishing",
    "Raku programming guide": "Perl",
    "Chisel set": "Woodworking",
    "Custom dice": "Tabletop RPGs",
    "“War and Peace” American film copy": "Old Movies",
    "Yarn": "Knitting",
    "“One Piece” graphic novel": "Manga",
    "“War and Peace” novel": "Historical Fiction Novels",
    "Starbucks gift card": "Coffee",
    "Foam exercise mat": "Yoga"
}

matched = set()
for gift, intr in interest_map.items():
    for name, ints in profiles.items():
        if intr in ints:
            matched.add(name)

missing = set(employees) - matched
print("Matched employees:")
for m in sorted(list(matched)):
    print(m)
print("\nMissing (no gift matched):")
for miss in missing:
    print(miss)
```
